title: Reproduction code and screened corpus for a survey of evaluation design in reinforcement learning route guidance

creators.name: Lee, Donghoun
creators.affiliation: Department of Artificial Intelligence and Data Science, Sejong University, Seoul, Republic of Korea

description: Reproduction material for the survey "Study-Area Boundaries in Reinforcement Learning-Based Route Guidance: A Survey of Evaluation Design and Reporting Requirements" by Donghoun Lee. The archive contains the study record of the review, the extracted full texts the lexical scans read, the evaluation-substrate and term-family scans, the grid, benchmark and SUMO environments with the planner and the training code, the run outputs behind every printed table and figure, the discount-consistent shaping variant and its controls, the retraining of a published router under each boundary condition, and the published network data the exact solvers read. RUN_TO_TABLE.md maps every printed cell to the file that produces it, names the key inside that file, and states which of the two reward variants the cell reports. Every value reported in the paper is recomputed from this tree at a linear-algebra thread count pinned to one.
